children: RaveDAO has scheduled an unlock of 21.38 million RAVE for July 2027. The tokens in the release are allocated to the community, the ecosystem, the foundation, investors and the RaveDAO team.
The tokens due to be released equal 7.78% of the circulating supply. Recipients gain access to their allocations when the unlock takes place, giving them more RAVE they can sell.

title: RaveDAO: 21.38 Million RAVE Unlocks - Jul 2027
